Run the bring-up self-test and confirm nominal telemetry.
Calibrate the VASIMR against its reference standard before full operation.
requirements: Power and signal conditioning to spec
standards: Burn-in / life test on a sample lot
Traceability of every unit to its lot
safety: De-energize before handling high-power units
ESD precautions for sensitive electronics
Respect thermal limits during bring-up
Lock out the system before mechanical work
troubleshooting: No output: check power rails and enable lines first
Intermittent faults: reseat connectors and check grounding
Overheating: verify thermal path and load current
Out-of-spec readings: re-run calibration, then swap with a known-good unit
citations: Documented public research on Deep Space Ion Thrusters: peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.
